LESSON: FABRIC DECORATION: TIE AND DYE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: FINE ARTS
Strand: Multimedia Arts (2D Art)
Topic 2.3: Fabric Decoration: Tie and Dye
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fabric Decoration: Tie and Dye, part of Multimedia Arts (2D Art) in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 FINE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: What is the cultural significance of tye and dye? 2. How do the different binding techniques affect the resultant patterns?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Fabric Decoration: Tie and Dye together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: as the learner researches the tie and dye concept with keen focus on West Africa, Europe/China.

● Digital literacy: as the learner interacts with digital devices to search information on characteristics of fabrics

decorated tie and dye techniques

● Collaboration: as the learner actively collaborates in sourcing and cleaning used cotton fabrics

Values:
● Unity: as the learner cooperates with peers to collaboratively source and clean used cotton fabrics

● Love: as the learner shows generosity by sharing materials for tie and dye

● Integrity: as the learner shows accountability while handling tools and materials used in fabric decoration (tie

and dye)

Suggested Learning Resources:

Internet connectivity, reference materials, reused cotton fabric, dyeing chemicals/fixatives, dye stuff, strong twine, source of

heat , cutting tools, containers among others.

Other Related Service Providers:

Resource person, Speech Therapist , Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist,
